verses.textZh: 俄巴底亚所见的异象。 主耶和华指着以东这样说： 我们从耶和华那里听见了一个信息， 有一位使者被派往列国去，说： "起来吧！我们起来与以东争战。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 俄巴底亚所见的异象。 主耶和华指着以东这样说： 我们从耶和华那里听见了一个信息， 有一位使者被派往列国去，说： "起来吧！我们起来与以东争战。"
verses.textZhCuv: 俄巴底亚得了耶和华的默示。 论以东说： 我从耶和华那里听见信息， 并有使者被差往列国去， 说：起来吧， 一同起来与以东争战！
verses.textEnNiv: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Sovereign Lord says about Edom— We have heard a message from the Lord : An envoy was sent to the nations to say, "Rise, let us go against her for battle"—
verses.textEnEsv: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says the Lord God concerning Edom: We have heard a report from the Lord , and a messenger has been sent among the nations: "Rise up! Let us rise against her for battle!"
verses.textEnNkjv: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says the Lord God concerning Edom (We have heard a report from the Lord, And a messenger has been sent among the nations, saying, "Arise, and let us rise up against her for battle"):
verses.textEnNlt: This is the vision that the Sovereign Lord revealed to Obadiah concerning the land of Edom. We have heard a message from the Lord that an ambassador was sent to the nations to say, "Get ready, everyone! Let’s assemble our armies and attack Edom!"
verses.textEnNasb: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord God says concerning Edom— We have heard a report from the Lord, And a messenger has been sent among the nations saying, "Arise, and let’s go up against her for battle"—
verses.textEn: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Sovereign Lord says about Edom— We have heard a message from the Lord : An envoy was sent to the nations to say, "Rise, let us go against her for battle"—

verses.textZh: 看哪！我必使你在列国中成为弱小的， 你必大受藐视。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我必使你在列国中成为弱小的， 你必大受藐视。
verses.textZhCuv: 我使你－以东在列国中为最小的， 被人大大藐视。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, I will make you small among the nations; you will be utterly despised.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will make you small among the nations; you shall be utterly despised.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I will make you small among the nations; You shall be greatly despised.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says to Edom, "I will cut you down to size among the nations; you will be greatly despised.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I will make you small among the nations; You are greatly despised.
verses.textEn: "See, I will make you small among the nations; you will be utterly despised.

verses.textZh: 你心中的傲气欺骗了你； 你这住在岩石的隐密处， 居所在高处的啊！ 你心里说： "谁能把我拉下地呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你心中的傲气欺骗了你； 你这住在岩石的隐密处， 居所在高处的啊！ 你心里说： "谁能把我拉下地呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 住在山穴中、居所在高处的啊， 你因狂傲自欺， 心里说：谁能将我拉下地去呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rocks and make your home on the heights, you who say to yourself, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’
verses.textEnEsv: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rock, in your lofty dwelling, who say in your heart, "Who will bring me down to the ground?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The pride of your heart has deceived you, You who dwell in the clefts of the rock, Whose habitation is high; You who say in your heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’
verses.textEnNlt: You have been deceived by your own pride because you live in a rock fortress and make your home high in the mountains. ‘Who can ever reach us way up here?’ you ask boastfully.
verses.textEnNasb: "The arrogance of your heart has deceived you, The one who lives in the clefts of the rock, On the height of his dwelling place, Who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to earth?’
verses.textEn: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rocks and make your home on the heights, you who say to yourself, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’

verses.textZh: 你虽如鹰高飞， 在星宿之间搭窝， 我也必从那里把你拉下来。 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你虽如鹰高飞， 在星宿之间搭窝， 我也必从那里把你拉下来。 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你虽如大鹰高飞， 在星宿之间搭窝， 我必从那里拉下你来。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Though you soar aloft like the eagle, though your nest is set among the stars, from there I will bring you down, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Though you ascend as high as the eagle, And though you set your nest among the stars, From there I will bring you down," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But even if you soar as high as eagles and build your nest among the stars, I will bring you crashing down," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Though you make your home high like the eagle, Though you set your nest among the stars, From there I will bring you down," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 窃贼若来到你那里， 强盗若夜间来到， 岂不会偷窃直到够了呢？ 你将会怎样被灭绝！ 摘葡萄的若来到你那里， 岂不只剩下几粒葡萄吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 窃贼若来到你那里， 强盗若夜间来到， 岂不会偷窃直到够了呢？ 你将会怎样被灭绝！ 摘葡萄的若来到你那里， 岂不只剩下几粒葡萄吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 盗贼若来在你那里， 或强盗夜间而来－ 你何竟被剪除－ 岂不偷窃直到够了呢？ 摘葡萄的若来到你那里， 岂不剩下些葡萄呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "If thieves came to you, if robbers in the night— oh, what a disaster awaits you!— would they not steal only as much as they wanted? If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes?
verses.textEnEsv: If thieves came to you, if plunderers came by night— how you have been destroyed!— would they not steal only enough for themselves? If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave gleanings?
verses.textEnNkjv: "If thieves had come to you, If robbers by night— Oh, how you will be cut off!— Would they not have stolen till they had enough? If grape-gatherers had come to you, Would they not have left some gleanings?
verses.textEnNlt: "If thieves came at night and robbed you (what a disaster awaits you!), they would not take everything. Those who harvest grapes always leave a few for the poor. But your enemies will wipe you out completely!
verses.textEnNasb: "If thieves came to you, If robbers by night— Oh how you will be ruined!— Would they not steal only until they had enough? If grape-pickers came to you, Would they not leave some gleanings?
verses.textEn: "If thieves came to you, if robbers in the night— oh, what a disaster awaits you!— would they not steal only as much as they wanted? If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes?

verses.textZh: 以扫要怎样被搜索， 他收藏的宝物被搜查出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫要怎样被搜索， 他收藏的宝物被搜查出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫的隐密处何竟被搜寻？ 他隐藏的宝物何竟被查出？
verses.textEnNiv: But how Esau will be ransacked, his hidden treasures pillaged!
verses.textEnEsv: How Esau has been pillaged, his treasures sought out!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Oh, how Esau shall be searched out! How his hidden treasures shall be sought after!
verses.textEnNlt: Every nook and cranny of Edom will be searched and looted. Every treasure will be found and taken.
verses.textEnNasb: "Oh how Esau will be searched, And his hidden treasures searched out!
verses.textEn: But how Esau will be ransacked, his hidden treasures pillaged!

verses.textZh: 曾与你结盟的， 都把你送到边界； 本来与你友好的， 却欺骗你，胜过你； 与你同席的 ， 在你脚下暗设网罗， 你却毫不晓得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 曾与你结盟的， 都把你送到边界； 本来与你友好的， 却欺骗你，胜过你； 与你同席的 ， 在你脚下暗设网罗， 你却毫不晓得。
verses.textZhCuv: 与你结盟的都送你上路，直到交界； 与你和好的欺骗你，且胜过你； 与你一同吃饭的设下网罗陷害你； 在你心里毫无聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: All your allies will force you to the border; your friends will deceive and overpower you; those who eat your bread will set a trap for you, but you will not detect it.
verses.textEnEsv: All your allies have driven you to your border; those at peace with you have deceived you; they have prevailed against you; those who eat your bread have set a trap beneath you— you have no understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the men in your confederacy Shall force you to the border; The men at peace with you Shall deceive you and prevail against you. Thosewhoeat your bread shall lay a trap for you. No one is aware of it.
verses.textEnNlt: "All your allies will turn against you. They will help to chase you from your land. They will promise you peace while plotting to deceive and destroy you. Your trusted friends will set traps for you, and you won’t even know about it.
verses.textEnNasb: "All the people allied with you Will send you to the border, And the people at peace with you Will deceive you and overpower you. They who eat your bread Will set an ambush for you. (There is no understanding in him.)
verses.textEn: All your allies will force you to the border; your friends will deceive and overpower you; those who eat your bread will set a trap for you, but you will not detect it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华宣告说：到那日， 我岂不从以东灭绝智慧人吗？ 岂不从以扫山除掉聪明人吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华宣告说：到那日， 我岂不从以东灭绝智慧人吗？ 岂不从以扫山除掉聪明人吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：到那日， 我岂不从以东除灭智慧人？ 从以扫山除灭聪明人？
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day," declares the Lord , "will I not destroy the wise men of Edom, those of understanding in the mountains of Esau?
verses.textEnEsv: Will I not on that day, declares the Lord , destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of Mount Esau?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Will I not in that day," says the Lord, "Even destroy the wise men from Edom, And understanding from the mountains of Esau?
verses.textEnNlt: At that time not a single wise person will be left in the whole land of Edom," says the Lord . "For on the mountains of Edom I will destroy everyone who has understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: "Will I not on that day," declares the Lord, "Eliminate wise men from Edom, And understanding from the mountain of Esau?
verses.textEn: "In that day," declares the Lord , "will I not destroy the wise men of Edom, those of understanding in the mountains of Esau?

verses.textZh: 提幔哪！你的勇士要惊惶， 因此在以扫山上人人被杀戮剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 提幔哪！你的勇士要惊惶， 因此在以扫山上人人被杀戮剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 提幔哪， 你的勇士必惊惶， 甚至以扫山的人都被杀戮剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: Your warriors, Teman, will be terrified, and everyone in Esau’s mountains will be cut down in the slaughter.
verses.textEnEsv: And your mighty men shall be dismayed, O Teman, so that every man from Mount Esau will be cut off by slaughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then your mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, To the end that everyone from the mountains of Esau May be cut off by slaughter.
verses.textEnNlt: The mightiest warriors of Teman will be terrified, and everyone on the mountains of Edom will be cut down in the slaughter.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then your warriors will be filled with terror, Teman, So that everyone will be eliminated from the mountain of Esau by murder.
verses.textEn: Your warriors, Teman, will be terrified, and everyone in Esau’s mountains will be cut down in the slaughter.

verses.textZh: 因你对兄弟雅各行强暴， 你必受羞辱， 永被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你对兄弟雅各行强暴， 你必受羞辱， 永被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你向兄弟雅各行强暴， 羞愧必遮盖你， 你也必永远断绝。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame; you will be destroyed forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Because of the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame shall cover you, and you shall be cut off forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For violence against your brother Jacob, Shame shall cover you, And you shall be cut off forever.
verses.textEnNlt: "Because of the violence you did to your close relatives in Israel, you will be filled with shame and destroyed forever.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because of violence to your brother Jacob, Shame will cover you, And you will be eliminated forever.
verses.textEn: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame; you will be destroyed forever.

verses.textZh: 外地人劫掠雅各财物的日子， 外族人进入他的城门， 为耶路撒冷抽签； 那时你竟袖手旁观， 甚至好象他们中间的一分子！
verses.textZhCnvs: 外地人劫掠雅各财物的日子， 外族人进入他的城门， 为耶路撒冷抽签； 那时你竟袖手旁观， 甚至好象他们中间的一分子！
verses.textZhCuv: 当外人掳掠雅各的财物， 外邦人进入他的城门， 为耶路撒冷拈阄的日子， 你竟站在一旁，像与他们同伙。
verses.textEnNiv: On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, you were like one of them.
verses.textEnEsv: On the day that you stood aloof, on the day that strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, you were like one of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the day that you stood on the other side— In the day that strangers carried captive his forces, When foreigners entered his gates And cast lots for Jerusalem— Even you were as one of them.
verses.textEnNlt: When they were invaded, you stood aloof, refusing to help them. Foreign invaders carried off their wealth and cast lots to divide up Jerusalem, but you acted like one of Israel’s enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: "On the day that you stood aloof, On the day that strangers carried off his wealth, And foreigners entered his gate And cast lots for Jerusalem— You too were as one of them.
verses.textEn: On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, you were like one of them.

verses.textZh: 你兄弟遭遇祸患的日子， 你不该看着不理； 犹大人被灭的日子， 你不该幸灾乐祸； 他们遭难的日子， 你不该张口狂傲；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你兄弟遭遇祸患的日子， 你不该看着不理； 犹大人被灭的日子， 你不该幸灾乐祸； 他们遭难的日子， 你不该张口狂傲；
verses.textZhCuv: 你兄弟遭难的日子， 你不当瞪眼看着； 犹大人被灭的日子， 你不当因此欢乐； 他们遭难的日子， 你不当说狂傲的话。
verses.textEnNiv: You should not gloat over your brother in the day of his misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast so much in the day of their trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: But do not gloat over the day of your brother in the day of his misfortune; do not rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their ruin; do not boast in the day of distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you should not have gazed on the day of your brother In the day of his captivity; Nor should you have rejoiced over the children of Judah In the day of their destruction; Nor should you have spoken proudly In the day of distress.
verses.textEnNlt: "You should not have gloated when they exiled your relatives to distant lands. You should not have rejoiced when the people of Judah suffered such misfortune. You should not have spoken arrogantly in that terrible time of trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not gloat over your brother’s day, The day of his misfortune. And do not rejoice over the sons of Judah On the day of their destruction; Yes, do not boast On the day of their distress.
verses.textEn: You should not gloat over your brother in the day of his misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast so much in the day of their trouble.

verses.textZh: 我子民遭灾的日子， 你不该进入他们的城门； 他们遭灾的日子， 你不该看着他们受苦； 他们遭灾的日子， 你不该抢夺他们的财物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我子民遭灾的日子， 你不该进入他们的城门； 他们遭灾的日子， 你不该看着他们受苦； 他们遭灾的日子， 你不该抢夺他们的财物。
verses.textZhCuv: 我民遭灾的日子， 你不当进他们的城门； 他们遭灾的日子， 你不当瞪眼看着他们受苦； 他们遭灾的日子， 你不当伸手抢他们的财物；
verses.textEnNiv: You should not march through the gates of my people in the day of their disaster, nor gloat over them in their calamity in the day of their disaster, nor seize their wealth in the day of their disaster.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not enter the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; do not gloat over his disaster in the day of his calamity; do not loot his wealth in the day of his calamity.
verses.textEnNkjv: You should not have entered the gate of My people In the day of their calamity. Indeed, you should not have gazed on their affliction In the day of their calamity, Nor laid hands on their substance In the day of their calamity.
verses.textEnNlt: You should not have plundered the land of Israel when they were suffering such calamity. You should not have gloated over their destruction when they were suffering such calamity. You should not have seized their wealth when they were suffering such calamity.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not enter the gate of My people On the day of their disaster. You indeed, do not gloat over their catastrophe On the day of their disaster. And do not lay a hand on their wealth On the day of their disaster.
verses.textEn: You should not march through the gates of my people in the day of their disaster, nor gloat over them in their calamity in the day of their disaster, nor seize their wealth in the day of their disaster.

verses.textZh: 你不该站在岔路口， 剪除他们中间逃脱的人； 他们遭难的日子， 你不该把他们生还的人交出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不该站在岔路口， 剪除他们中间逃脱的人； 他们遭难的日子， 你不该把他们生还的人交出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不当站在岔路口剪除他们中间逃脱的； 他们遭难的日子， 你不当将他们剩下的人交付仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: You should not wait at the crossroads to cut down their fugitives, nor hand over their survivors in the day of their trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not stand at the crossroads to cut off his fugitives; do not hand over his survivors in the day of distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: You should not have stood at the crossroads To cut off those among them who escaped; Nor should you have delivered up those among them who remained In the day of distress.
verses.textEnNlt: You should not have stood at the crossroads, killing those who tried to escape. You should not have captured the survivors and handed them over in their terrible time of trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not stand at the crossroads To eliminate their survivors; And do not hand over their refugees On the day of their distress.
verses.textEn: You should not wait at the crossroads to cut down their fugitives, nor hand over their survivors in the day of their trouble.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的日子临近万国了， 人必照你所行的向你施行， 你的报应必归到你的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的日子临近万国了， 人必照你所行的向你施行， 你的报应必归到你的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华降罚的日子临近万国。 你怎样行，他也必照样向你行； 你的报应必归到你头上。
verses.textEnNiv: "The day of the Lord is near for all nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your deeds will return upon your own head.
verses.textEnEsv: For the day of the Lord is near upon all the nations. As you have done, it shall be done to you; your deeds shall return on your own head.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For the day of the Lord upon all the nations is near; As you have done, it shall be done to you; Your reprisal shall return upon your own head.
verses.textEnNlt: "The day is near when I, the Lord , will judge all godless nations! As you have done to Israel, so it will be done to you. All your evil deeds will fall back on your own heads.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the day of the Lord is near for all the nations. Just as you have done, it will be done to you. Your dealings will return on your own head.
verses.textEn: "The day of the Lord is near for all nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your deeds will return upon your own head.

verses.textZh: 你们怎样在我的圣山上喝过苦杯， 万国也必照样不住地喝， 他们要喝，并且要吞下去， 他们就不再存在了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们怎样在我的圣山上喝过苦杯， 万国也必照样不住地喝， 他们要喝，并且要吞下去， 他们就不再存在了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们犹大人在我圣山怎样喝了苦杯， 万国也必照样常常地喝； 且喝且咽，他们就归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as you drank on my holy hill, so all the nations will drink continually; they will drink and drink and be as if they had never been.
verses.textEnEsv: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations shall drink continually; they shall drink and swallow, and shall be as though they had never been.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as you drank on My holy mountain, So shall all the nations drink continually; Yes, they shall drink, and swallow, And they shall be as though they had never been.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as you swallowed up my people on my holy mountain, so you and the surrounding nations will swallow the punishment I pour out on you. Yes, all you nations will drink and stagger and disappear from history.
verses.textEnNasb: "For just as you drank on My holy mountain, All the nations will drink continually. They will drink to the last drop, And become as if they had never existed.
verses.textEn: Just as you drank on my holy hill, so all the nations will drink continually; they will drink and drink and be as if they had never been.

verses.textZh: 但在锡安山上必有逃脱的人， 那山必成为圣； 雅各家必得回他们原有的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但在锡安山上必有逃脱的人， 那山必成为圣； 雅各家必得回他们原有的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 在锡安山必有逃脱的人， 那山也必成圣； 雅各家必得原有的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: But on Mount Zion will be deliverance; it will be holy, and Jacob will possess his inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: But in Mount Zion there shall be those who escape, and it shall be holy, and the house of Jacob shall possess their own possessions.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But on Mount Zion there shall be deliverance, And there shall be holiness; The house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
verses.textEnNlt: "But Jerusalem will become a refuge for those who escape; it will be a holy place. And the people of Israel will come back to reclaim their inheritance.
verses.textEnNasb: "But on Mount Zion there will be those who escape, And it will be holy. And the house of Jacob will possess their property.
verses.textEn: But on Mount Zion will be deliverance; it will be holy, and Jacob will possess his inheritance.

verses.textZh: 雅各家必成为火， 约瑟家必成为火焰； 以扫家却像碎秸， 被它们焚烧吞灭， 以扫家再没有生还的人了。 因为耶和华已经说了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各家必成为火， 约瑟家必成为火焰； 以扫家却像碎秸， 被它们焚烧吞灭， 以扫家再没有生还的人了。 因为耶和华已经说了。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各家必成为大火； 约瑟家必为火焰； 以扫家必如碎秸； 火必将他烧着吞灭。 以扫家必无余剩的。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob will be a fire and Joseph a flame; Esau will be stubble, and they will set him on fire and destroy him. There will be no survivors from Esau." The Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: The house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau stubble; they shall burn them and consume them, and there shall be no survivor for the house of Esau, for the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: The house of Jacob shall be a fire, And the house of Joseph a flame; But the house of Esau shallbe stubble; They shall kindle them and devour them, And no survivor shall remain of the house of Esau," For the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel will be a raging fire, and Edom a field of dry stubble. The descendants of Joseph will be a flame roaring across the field, devouring everything. There will be no survivors in Edom. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the house of Jacob will be a fire, And the house of Joseph a flame; But the house of Esau will be like stubble. And they will set them on fire and consume them, So that there will be no survivor of the house of Esau," For the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEn: Jacob will be a fire and Joseph a flame; Esau will be stubble, and they will set him on fire and destroy him. There will be no survivors from Esau." The Lord has spoken.

verses.textZh: 南地的人必占有以扫山， 低地的人必占有非利士人之地； 他们必占有以法莲的田野和撒玛利亚的田野； 便雅悯人必占有基列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 南地的人必占有以扫山， 低地的人必占有非利士人之地； 他们必占有以法莲的田野和撒玛利亚的田野； 便雅悯人必占有基列。
verses.textZhCuv: 南地的人必得以扫山； 高原的人必得非利士地， 也得以法莲地和撒马利亚地； 便雅悯人必得基列。
verses.textEnNiv: People from the Negev will occupy the mountains of Esau, and people from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: Those of the Negeb shall possess Mount Esau, and those of the Shephelah shall possess the land of the Philistines; they shall possess the land of Ephraim and the land of Samaria, and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: The South shall possess the mountains of Esau, And the Lowland shall possess Philistia. They shall possess the fields of Ephraim And the fields of Samaria. Benjamin shallpossess Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then my people living in the Negev will occupy the mountains of Edom. Those living in the foothills of Judah will possess the Philistine plains and take over the fields of Ephraim and Samaria. And the people of Benjamin will occupy the land of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: Then those of the Negev will possess the mountain of Esau, And those of the Shephelah the Philistine plain; Also, they will possess the territory of Ephraim and the territory of Samaria, And Benjamin the territory of Gilead.
verses.textEn: People from the Negev will occupy the mountains of Esau, and people from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.

verses.textZh: 被掳到哈腊的以色列人， 必占有迦南人的地，直到撒勒法； 被掳到西法拉的耶路撒冷的人， 要占有南地众城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被掳到哈腊的以色列人， 必占有迦南人的地，直到撒勒法； 被掳到西法拉的耶路撒冷的人， 要占有南地众城。
verses.textZhCuv: 在迦南人中被掳的以色列众人 必得地直到撒勒法； 在西法拉中被掳的耶路撒冷人 必得南地的城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: This company of Israelite exiles who are in Canaan will possess the land as far as Zarephath; the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the towns of the Negev.
verses.textEnEsv: The exiles of this host of the people of Israel shall possess the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath, and the exiles of Jerusalem who are in Sepharad shall possess the cities of the Negeb.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the captives of this host of the children of Israel Shallpossesstheland of the Canaanites As far as Zarephath. The captives of Jerusalem who are in Sepharad Shall possess the cities of the South.
verses.textEnNlt: The exiles of Israel will return to their land and occupy the Phoenician coast as far north as Zarephath. The captives from Jerusalem exiled in the north will return home and resettle the towns of the Negev.
verses.textEnNasb: And the exiles of this army of the sons of Israel, Who are among the Canaanites as far as Zarephath, And the exiles of Jerusalem who are in Sepharad, Will possess the cities of the Negev.
verses.textEn: This company of Israelite exiles who are in Canaan will possess the land as far as Zarephath; the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the towns of the Negev.

verses.textZh: 必有拯救者登锡安山， 审判以扫山， 国权就属于耶和华了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有拯救者登锡安山， 审判以扫山， 国权就属于耶和华了。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有拯救者上到锡安山，审判以扫山； 国度就归耶和华了。
verses.textEnNiv: Deliverers will go up on Mount Zion to govern the mountains of Esau. And the kingdom will be the Lord ’s.
verses.textEnEsv: Saviors shall go up to Mount Zion to rule Mount Esau, and the kingdom shall be the Lord ’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then saviors shall come to Mount Zion To judge the mountains of Esau, And the kingdom shall be the Lord’s.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who have been rescued will go up to Mount Zion in Jerusalem to rule over the mountains of Edom. And the Lord himself will be king!"
verses.textEnNasb: The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion To judge the mountain of Esau, And the kingdom will be the Lord’s.
verses.textEn: Deliverers will go up on Mount Zion to govern the mountains of Esau. And the kingdom will be the Lord ’s.
